The next critical date is **15 December 2026**, the deadline for written non-renewal notice. If no notice is given, the current term ends on **15 March 2027** and the agreement automatically renews for one year. [2]

redis.delta_text:
The timeline shows the Atlas Logistics agreement was signed on **14 March 2023**, with services beginning on **1 April 2023**. Key intervening events include a pricing amendment, an SLA breach notice, service credits, and the 2026 annual price uplift. [1][2]

The next critical date is **15 December 2026**, the deadline for written non-renewal notice. If no notice is given, the current term ends on **15 March 2027** and the agreement automatically renews for one year. [2]

events.detail: Three-year master services agreement executed by the Company and Atlas Logistics.

source.excerpt: The current term ends on 15 March 2027, so the renewal notice deadline is 15 December 2026. ## Contract history - **14 March 2023 - MSA signed.** The three-year master services agreement was signed. - **1 April 2023 - Services start.** The first shipments under the agreement.

events.title: Services began
events.detail: First shipments under the agreement.

source.excerpt: - **1 April 2023 - Services start.** The first shipments under the agreement. - **9 February 2024 - Amendment 1.** Prices rose by 3.5 percent and the fuel surcharge was folded into the base rate.

events.title: Amendment 1
events.detail: Prices increased by 3.5%; the fuel surcharge was incorporated into the base rate.

source.excerpt: - **9 February 2024 - Amendment 1.** Prices rose by 3.5 percent and the fuel surcharge was folded into the base rate. - **November 2024 - SLA breach notice.** Atlas missed three delivery windows in October 2024.

events.title: SLA breach notice
events.detail: Notice issued after Atlas missed three delivery windows in October 2024.

source.excerpt: - **November 2024 - SLA breach notice.** Atlas missed three delivery windows in October 2024. - **15 January 2025 - Service credits applied.** Credits of 18,400 euros were applied to the January invoice.

events.detail: €18,400 in credits applied to the January invoice.

source.excerpt: - **15 January 2025 - Service credits applied.** Credits of 18,400 euros were applied to the January invoice. - **1 April 2026 - Annual price uplift.** Prices rose by 3.1 percent, within the 4 percent cap.

events.detail: Prices increased by 3.1%, within the 4% contractual cap.

source.excerpt: - **1 April 2026 - Annual price uplift.** Prices rose by 3.1 percent, within the 4 percent cap. ## Upcoming deadlines and milestones - **15 December 2026 - Renewal notice deadline.** Last day to give notice of non-renewal.
